imports: import { Ae, R, Rt, le, en, qt } from './plugin-chain-react-hooks.js';

blocks.note: $e: whether a node's measured box is visible inside the terminal rows, subtracting ancestor scroll
N4: the visibility hook — a ref callback, the visible flag, the initial measurement and the remeasure closure
Io and LIe (the 480 ms repaint floor under the full-repaint flag) and ia, the animation clock: quantized frame time from the mounted clock, paused while hidden or without a clock
vie: clamp a node's scroll offset to its content height
the terminal focus context with its default value
d, Qc and kie: the context alias and its two readers
nI, Cje and T4n: the timeout helper and the no-op subscribe/read functions
eg and the timing constants; eg is the frame quantum
Dy and y4n: the internal accessibility context
